# HR Daily Advisor

> HR Daily Advisor delivers free, timely guidance on employment law, HR compliance, workplace culture, and talent management for HR professionals.

Published by the Human Capital Institute (HCI), HR Daily Advisor provides news, research, white papers, and multimedia content covering critical HR topics including EEOC enforcement, DEI initiatives, pension regulations, and leadership development. The site serves as a comprehensive resource for staying current on employment law changes and HR best practices.

## Key Topics

- HR Compliance
- Employment Law
- EEOC Enforcement
- DEI & Diversity
- Workplace Harassment
- Talent Development
- HR Leadership
- Pension Plans & ERISA
- Employee Engagement
- Career Development
- Workplace Culture
- AI in HR
- Gender Pay Gap
- Virtual Events & Webinars
- Human Capital Institute (HCI)

## Core Navigation

- [HR Daily Advisor](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org): Homepage featuring HR compliance, employment law, and workplace guidance
- [Categories](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org/categories): Content hub organizing HR topics: compliance, benefits, DEI, leadership
- [About HR Daily Advisor](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org/about): About page describing HR Daily Advisor as free HR news resource
- [Subscribe](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org/subscribe): Newsletter subscription page for HR Daily Advisor by HCI
- [Human Capital Institute](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org/human-capital-institute): Human Capital Institute (HCI) certifications and professional development

## Compliance & Legal News

- [EEOC Rescinds 2024 Workplace Harassment Guidance: What Employers Need to Know](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org/2026/03/20/eeoc-rescinds-2024-workplace-harassment-guidance-what-employers-need-to-know): EEOC rescinds harassment guidance; impacts Title VII compliance and DEI
- [The EEOC Continues to Take a Stand Against DEI Programs](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org/2026/03/18/the-eeoc-continues-to-take-a-stand-against-dei-programs): EEOC enforcement action against Nike DEI policies and reverse discrimination
- [Supreme Court to Decide Timing of Actuarial Assumptions in Withdrawal Liability Calculations](https://hrdailyadvisor.hci.org/2026/03/20/supreme-court-to-decide-timing-of-actuarial-assumptions-in-withdrawal-liability-calculations): Supreme Court reviews multiemployer pension plan withdrawal liability under MPPAA
